camel_example: aliyun ice DetectAudioForCustomizedVoiceJob --region cn-hangzhou --RecordUrl 'https://your-bucket.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/record1.wav' --VoiceId xiaozhuan --AudioRecordId 1 --version 2020-11-09 --method POST --force
description_en: Checks whether the user's reading contains obvious pronunciation errors or background noise. After the audio check is completed, qualified audio files are temporarily stored in the cloud for subsequent voice training. Do not skip this step
description_zh:
本接口用来检测用户的朗读是否有明显的发音错误、嘈杂的环境等。
云端在进行完音频检测后，对于检测合格的音频会暂存在云端，供后续训练声音时使用，请勿省略该步骤
name: DetectAudioForCustomizedVoiceJob

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the recording file.
<notice>The URL must point to an Object Storage Service (OSS) object in your account, and the region of the OSS bucket must be the same as the region where the service is deployed when you call this operation.</notice>
<notice>Audio format requirements: The audio file must be in WAV or PCM format, and must be a mono audio file with a 16-bit sample depth and a sample rate of 48,000 Hz.</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
录音文件 URL 地址
<notice>必须是您账号下的 OSS 地址，并且 OSS Bucket 的所在区域要与调用本接口时服务所在的区域相同></notice>
<notice>音频格式要求：音频文件必须是 wav 或 pcm 格式，且为单声道（mono）16 bit 采样位数音频。音频采样率为 48000 Hz></notice>
parameters.name: record_url

parameters.help_en: The audio sequence number corresponding to the RecordUrl parameter
parameters.name: audio_record_id

Pass.description_en:
Indicates whether the audio passed the check. Valid values:

true: The audio passed the check.
false: The audio failed the check
Pass.description_zh:
是否通过检测，取值：

true：检测成功。
false：检测失败

Reason.description_en: The specific reason why the audio failed the check
Reason.description_zh: 检测失败时给出具体原因
Reason.example: Pronunciation error, please read the contents of the copy accurately

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation was successful. Valid values:
true: The operation was successful.
false: The operation failed
Success.description_zh: 操作是否成功。取值：true：成功。false：失败
